heading: G8_Area And Perimeter Real Life Word Problems

topics.heading: Area And Perimeter Real Life Word Problems

question:
A playground is made by joining a rectangular field and a square play area as shown.

Artificial grass costs $4 per m².

What is the total cost of covering the entire playground with artificial grass?
Answer = $______

A decorative signboard consists of a square with a triangular top, as shown.

The front surface is to be painted.

If painting costs $5 per m², what is the total painting cost?
Answer = $______

A flower bed has a rectangular middle section with a triangular section attached at each end, as shown.

Fertiliser is needed for the entire flower bed.

If 1 bag covers 10 m², how many bags are required?
Answer = ______ bags

A park has a parallelogram-shaped lawn with a triangular flower garden attached to one side, as shown.

Grass seed costs $3 per m².

How much will it cost to cover the entire lawn?
Answer = $______

Two triangular gardens are joined together as shown.

A gardener wants to spread mulch over the whole garden.

If one bag covers 8 m², how many bags are needed?
Answer = ______ bags

A community park consists of a rectangular lawn, a square play area and a triangular flower bed, as shown.

The entire park is to be covered with new turf costing $2 per m².

What is the total cost?
Answer = $______

A building has an L-shaped floor plan, as shown.

A skirting board will be installed all around the edge of the floor.

The skirting board costs $8 per m. What is the total cost of the skirting board?
Answer = $______

A rectangular lawn has a square pond removed, as shown.

A decorative fence will be installed all around the edge of the lawn, including the edges of the pond opening.

The fencing costs $5 per m. What is the total cost of the fencing?
Answer = $______

A rectangular garden has a square storage shed built, as shown.

A rope border is placed around the both boundaries of the garden.

If one roll of rope is 4 m long, how many rolls are needed?
Answer = ______ rolls

A rectangular park has a triangular section reserved for a fountain, as shown.

A safety barrier is to be placed around the outside edge of the remaining park.

Each roll of barrier is 5 m long. How many rolls are required?
Answer = ______ rolls

A rubber border is to be placed around the outside of the parallelogram-shaped sports court.
One side measures 1600 cm and the other side measures 13 m.

How many metres of border are required?
Answer = ______ m

A rectangular classroom floor measures 900 cm by 7 m.
Vinyl flooring costs $24 per m².
The school has a budget of $1,600.
Will the budget be enough?

A rectangular notice board measures 420 cm by 2.4 m.
Wooden trim will be placed around the edge.
Liam says that 13.2 m of trim is needed.
Rose says that 12.8 m of trim is needed.
Who is correct?

A square garden has sides measuring 0.02 km.
Oliver has 85 m of bricks to build a border around the garden.
Does Oliver have enough bricks?

A rectangular roof measures 1800 cm by 8 m.
Solar panels cost $220 per m².
Emma says it will cost $31,680 to cover the roof.
Jack says it will cost $30,800 to cover the roof.
Who is correct?

A triangular tent roof has a base of 1600 cm and a perpendicular height of 10 m.
Canvas costs $20 per m².
The organiser has $1,700 to buy the canvas.
Is this enough money?

A rectangular sports field measures 0.05 km long and 20 m wide.
A rope is placed all around the field.
The coach bought 150 m of rope.
Will all of the rope be used? If not, how many metres will be left over?

options.text: No, 10 m will be left over.
No, 5 m will be left over.
No, 10 m more will be needed.

question: A kite-shaped sports court has diagonals measuring 3 m and 1800 mm. Each pair of equal sides measures 2.5 m.

A protective fence will be installed all around the court at $24 per metre. The entire court will also be covered with a synthetic surface costing $45 per m².
What is the total cost of installing the fence and covering the court?
Answer = $______
A rhombus-shaped garden has diagonals measuring 280 cm and 1.5 m. Each side measures 1.7 m.

A decorative border will be installed around the garden at $18 per metre. The whole garden will also be covered with decorative stones costing $28 per m².
What is the total cost of completing the garden?
Answer = $______
A trapezium-shaped picnic area has parallel sides measuring 1600 cm and 24 m. The other two sides each measure 9 m. The perpendicular height is 8 m.

A wooden fence will be installed around the outside at $25 per metre. Artificial grass will be laid over the entire picnic area at $16 per m².
What is the total cost of fencing the picnic area and laying the artificial grass?
Answer = $______
A rectangular classroom floor measures 9 m by 6 m.

Square tiles with side length 30 cm are used to cover the floor. The tiles fit exactly without cutting.
How many tiles are required?
Answer = ______ tiles
A square courtyard has side length 12 m.

Rectangular paving slabs measuring 2 m by 1 m are laid without cutting or overlapping.
How many paving slabs are needed?
Answer = ______ slabs
